resources.string: Shown while a ride is recorded or navigated
Delete the diagnostics log on this phone?
So that your ride keeps being recorded with the display off, ElTouro needs these settings. Tap everything marked ✗ once.

Android likes to stop apps while the display is off. With “Allow all the time” ElTouro may pick the ride up again by itself. The app uses your location only while a ride is running – just as before. On the next page, choose “Allow all the time”.
A few settings are still missing so that your ride does not break off with the display off (for example battery optimization or location “Allow all the time”). It takes a minute.

1. Autostart: Settings → Apps → Manage apps → ElTouro → switch Autostart on (button “Autostart” below).
2. Battery: in the same app info → Battery saver → “No restrictions”.
3. Location: app info → Permissions → Location → “Allow all the time” and “Use precise location”.
4. Lock the app: open recent apps, press and hold ElTouro → tap the lock. Then HyperOS does not clear it away.
5. Do not ride in ultra battery saver – it stops everything.

1. Settings → Apps → ElTouro → Battery → “Unrestricted”.\n2. Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: ElTouro must not be under “Sleeping apps” or “Deep sleeping apps”; best add it to “Never sleeping apps”.\n3. Location: app info → Permissions → Location → “Allow all the time”, “Use precise location” on.

1. Settings → Battery → App launch → ElTouro: switch “Manage automatically” off and all three switches on (auto-launch, secondary launch, run in background).\n2. Location: app info → Permissions → Location → “Allow all the time”.\n3. In recent apps, pull ElTouro down to lock it.

1. Settings → Apps → ElTouro → Battery usage: “Allow background activity” and “Allow auto launch” on.\n2. Location: app info → Permissions → Location → “Allow all the time”.\n3. Lock ElTouro in recent apps (menu above the app → Lock).
1. Switch battery optimization off for ElTouro (button above).\n2. Location → “Allow all the time” and precise location.\n3. Keep battery saver off during the ride.
